description: This file provides font-lock (syntax highlighting) support for gyp files in Emacs, including mode definitions, indentation logic, and keyword highlighting.

methods.name: gyp-set-indentation
methods.description: Configures indentation settings for gyp mode.

methods.name: gyp-section-name
methods.description: Maps section strings to section symbols for font-locking.

methods.name: gyp-invalidate-parse-states-after
methods.description: Clears parse states after a given point.

methods.name: gyp-parse-point
methods.description: Returns the last parse state point.

methods.name: gyp-parse-sections
methods.description: Returns the list of sections at the last parse state.

methods.name: gyp-inside-dictionary-p
methods.description: Checks if parser is inside a dictionary.

methods.name: gyp-add-parse-history
methods.description: Adds parse state to history for incremental parsing.

methods.name: gyp-parse-to
methods.description: Parses buffer content up to target point, updating parse states.

methods.name: gyp-section-at-point
methods.description: Determines the section type at current point for font-locking.

methods.name: gyp-add-font-lock-keywords
methods.description: Adds syntax highlighting keywords for gyp mode.
